# Subject + 畀 + Doer + Verb · *Subject + bei2 + Doer + Verb*

**Meaning:** passive: was done by · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Passive

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fbei2-passive).

To say something was done to someone, use 畀 followed by who did it. If you don't know who, use 畀人 ('by someone'). Spoken Cantonese never uses written 被 here.

**Written Chinese:** 被 — Written Chinese uses 被.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我畀老細鬧咗。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 zo2. |
| Yale | ngóh béi lóuh sai naauh jó. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄅㄝㄧ² ㄌㄛㄨ⁵ ㄙㄜㄧ³ ㄋㄚㄨ⁶ ㄗㄛ². |
| English | I got told off by my boss. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我個銀包畀人偷咗。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 go3 ngan4 baau1 bei2 jan4 tau1 zo2. |
| Yale | ngóh go ngàhn bāau béi yàhn tāu jó. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄍㄛ³ ㆭㄜㄣ⁴ ㄅㄚㄨ¹ ㄅㄝㄧ² ㄧㄜㄣ⁴ ㄊㄜㄨ¹ ㄗㄛ². |
| English | My wallet was stolen. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **啲蛋糕畀細佬食晒。** |
| Jyutping | di1 daan6 gou1 bei2 sai3 lou2 sik6 saai3. |
| Yale | dī daahn gōu béi sai lóu sihk saai. |
| Bopomofo | ㄉㄧ¹ ㄉㄚㄣ⁶ ㄍㄛㄨ¹ ㄅㄝㄧ² ㄙㄜㄧ³ ㄌㄛㄨ² ㄙㄧㆶ⁶ ㄙㄚㄧ³. |
| English | My little brother ate all the cake. |

## Common mistakes

- ✗ ~~我的錢包被偷了。~~ → ✓ **我個銀包畀人偷咗。** *ngo5 go3 ngan4 baau1 bei2 jan4 tau1 zo2.* · *ngóh go ngàhn bāau béi yàhn tāu jó.*  
  的, 錢包, 被 and 了 are written forms.
